CHA₂DS₂-VASc Stroke Risk Score — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Six yes/no criteria and the age with the CHA₂DS₂-VASc score (0–9) for stroke risk in atrial fibrillation; a higher score means a higher risk.

Open in Builder

Scoring

Points: heart failure 1, hypertension 1, age 75 or older 2, diabetes 1, previous stroke or TIA 2, vascular disease 1, age 65 to 74 1, female sex 1 (0–9). The score appears once the age is entered; an unanswered criterion counts as No.

Questions

  1. Congestive heart failure or left ventricular dysfunction
  2. Hypertension
  3. Age (years)
  4. Diabetes mellitus
  5. Previous stroke, transient ischemic attack or thromboembolism
  6. Vascular disease (previous myocardial infarction, peripheral artery disease or aortic plaque)
  7. Female sex

Calculated results

  • CHA₂DS₂-VASc score (0–9)

Source and license

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “CHA₂DS₂-VASc Stroke Risk Score”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
